meta.title: Stepwise runs — one step, one run, one verdict
meta.description: 0.6 LABRIG: detached admission and immutable checks remain authoritative. 2026-09-07 adds stable delivery bindings and bounded evidence-backed implementation-guidance revisions without resetting spent attempts or marking old failures passed. UI separates current work from detailed evidence. Current backlog acceptance and remaining live checks: docs/backlog-fixes-2026-09-07.md; historical lifecycle evidence remains in docs/release-0.6-LABRIG.md.

nodes.label: The user's prompt
nodes.note: Used ONCE, to plan — and, after 2026-09-04, only after the model has read the code the task is about. Never re-injected per step: re-injecting it into every iteration is what let one run wander across the whole task.

nodes.label: Plan gate
nodes.sublabel: read first (bounded), then a FORCED commit_plan · hands off to the supervisor
nodes.note: Bounded safe DGV planning reads installed; mode/risk fences and forced commit retained. Revision d706d2b3a3ab. Local installation receipt retained privately.

nodes.label: Step criteria
nodes.sublabel: each step declares a check that CAN FAIL · constants and script paths rejected
nodes.note: Full check contracts and local coverage guidance installed; no semantic proof or old-plan rewrite. Local installation receipt retained privately.

flags.title: Generated checks do not establish full task coverage
flags.note: Historical evt_002948/003027: flat fixture256faces vs generated300threshold. Later run ac0a51719d6b502d7df1940a repaired seam behavior, reports528faces25quads100vertices and steps1–4 verified. That narrow pass is not full geometry proof. Step5 HUD/API predicate can be true despite runtime errors/zero rendered chunks (evt_003674); final evt_003742 browser observation unavailable. See docs/browser-recovery-tools-2026-09-06.md. Automatic versioned plan adaptation is pending, not shipped.
flags.fix: Preserve original benchmark coverage; use evidence-backed contract review for contradictory or inadequate generated checks. Do not reinterpret HUD presence as visible terrain or auto-amend acceptance on retry.

nodes.label: plan event
nodes.note: Immutable plan event identity and full plan.state snapshots; latest-plan reducer never inherits older indexed checkpoints.

nodes.label: Step supervisor
nodes.sublabel: owns the cursor · an autopilot turn with an unfinished plan RESUMES it
nodes.note: Persists attempt/revision/pair counters and selection cursor. All entry points use shared supervisor and safe control boundaries.

nodes.label: Step prompt writer
nodes.sublabel: the prompt for ONE step · its check verbatim · the SOURCE the plan was made from
nodes.note: Exact Verify JSON installed for steps/retries; original brief/images preserved. No benchmark pass claimed. Local installation receipt retained privately.

nodes.label: Revision decider
nodes.sublabel: reopen an earlier step as rev_n · cap 2 · re-verify downstream
nodes.note: Structured request_revision, invalidate dependent evidence BEFORE editing, target correction/verification then downstream checks. Selected scope suspends for out-of-scope repair.

nodes.label: Step run
nodes.sublabel: bounded model rounds · continuation requires checked repair progress
nodes.note: Installed 2026-09-06, revision a3a8367-dirty-45e4ab58c05d. Repair-based round extensions require changed declared source plus new committed-check evidence, not mutation alone. Existing one-time fresh-source inspection continuity retained; all guards remain. Three failed repair/check cycles hand back without fresh automatic attempt. Latest verification/event ID separate from execution stop. Earlier and later shared-file passes rechecked; selected scope preserved. Full release gates pass.

nodes.label: Step verify
nodes.sublabel: run the step's own check · pass / fail, with evidence · fails CLOSED · session registry
nodes.note: Installed 619383328f9d: invalidate declared shared-file passes before execution and recheck before advance; stale replay verifies without model rebuild. Selected never rechecks unselected prerequisites. No semantic proof beyond declared checks.

nodes.label: Tool registry
nodes.note: 2026-09-06: browser process isolation/bounded evidence, explicit unavailable statuses, awaited verification, and owned serve probe/root confinement tested. Installed headless shell resolves reproduced full-Chromium CLI hang; WebGL+ESM fixtures pass. No benchmark mutation. See docs/browser-recovery-tools-2026-09-06.md. Full release gate follows.

nodes.label: checkpoint event
nodes.sublabel: step N, rev R — verdict, the check, its evidence, and why
nodes.note: Canonical plan.state saved before projection-only compatibility checkpoint; interrupted process never manufactures a settled check.

nodes.label: events.jsonl
nodes.sublabel: one log · plan, runs, checkpoints, revisions

nodes.label: GET /report + /state
nodes.sublabel: GET /report + /state — status from checkpoints · /state carries the working log per reply
nodes.note: Installed9c527991491f: canonical reducer reports historical successful checks as awaiting recheck, not currently verified. Distinct needs_reverify/pending/running/unverified/skipped counts. Live Minecraft state verified 2 stale,1 blocked,5 pending,0 skipped.

nodes.label: Native plan strip
nodes.sublabel: SIMPLE surface · steps, which is running, pass/fail · no knobs
nodes.note: Installed 2026-09-06, revision a3a8367-dirty-45e4ab58c05d: canonical blocked-step label, compact incidents with technical disclosure, bounded multiline composer, non-overlay dock seam, grouped consecutive reads retaining receipts/failures, quiet flat sidebar. Browser fixtures pass four viewport/zoom configurations (build/recovery-ui-CNATJJ); 101 Vitest tests pass; Svelte reports zero errors/eight existing warnings. Live assets match package. No production retry submitted.

nodes.label: RFX Planner panel
nodes.sublabel: ADVANCED surface · calls runStep(), no longer writes prompts
nodes.note: Installed embedded Planner1.5.1 with builtin-wins precedence. Live build identity and served Planner asset verified; installed1.5.0 unchanged and ignored. Single-step Recover names/targets blocked index2 before stale Next0. Browser fixtures passed; actual session not resumed.

ports.shape: POST run-step {step, rev?} · POST auto {on} · GET plan-state

nodes.label: Step control API
nodes.sublabel: GET /plan · POST /plan/step — the one way to drive a plan
nodes.note: Plan-bound commands preserve one detached owner. Actual embedded Planner W8A16 acceptance PASS: continue138476378209f67abfacf52e completes2/2; selected2f137b8440434ee9f33bffd5 completes0,1 only, third pending with0attempts/no artifact. Browser closes after acceptance; fresh contexts display canonical counts. Isolated child crash/reopen tested mid-step, not resumed inference. Evidence: docs/release-0.6-LABRIG.md; scripts/qa-labrig-realcore.mjs.

nodes.label: Failure-aware recovery
nodes.note: Installed 2026-09-06 10:29 CEST: a3a8367-dirty-c71e1f303281, bundle v7w9uo. Preserve stale shared-file contract context; exact read_plan_step snapshots; evidence-backed verification review stops instead of fixture distortion or unbounded retries. Original Minecraft check still requires review; no benchmark mutation or retry. Full release gates passed; Core/embedding PIDs unchanged. Receipt: docs/verification-review-recovery-2026-09-06.md.

nodes.label: Evidence-backed verification review
nodes.note: Installed scoped immutable plan reader and verification-review handoff. Validates evidence identity and original check hash; persists fresh actual verdict, rejects stale execution/saves, survives restart before PlanState, cancels remaining batch and blocks even a disputed passing check. Generic retry does not approve or execute proposals. 227 loop tests + full Go race/vet and 101 frontend tests passed. Criterion validity and live model adoption remain unverified.

nodes.label: Structured checks + diagnostics
nodes.note: Typed existing Node/Go tests and Node/TS/Go diagnostics; scoped versions, hashed receipts, bounded summaries. Real fixtures and failure/omission tests pass.

nodes.label: Browser sequence + profile
nodes.note: Embedded fresh-page sequence/profile; exact local GET/HEAD proxy, 6 captures. Trusted input, stuck JS CPU evidence, unavailable metrics and byte limits fixture-tested.

nodes.label: Owned native process runner
nodes.note: Owned PID namespace + process group, bounded streams/time. Checks: RO host/workspace and no network. Cancellation/RO/output tests pass; bwrap absence fails closed.
